steps.text: Run a live Postgres write burst via holo backup:wal --json — WAL archives to R2 continuously, zero continuity gaps (status=success, continuityOk, R2 growth, writeBurstRows≥1); pipeline health proven by overall: OK (not the unrelated pg_stat_archiver failed counter).
Run the scheduled base-backup job — full backup lands in the R2 bucket, verified by manifest.
Run the restic blob-mirror job — every local/remote object SHA-256 matches.
Kill the backup job mid-archive — alert fires within 15 minutes, no dashboard-polling needed. (REDHAT-FIX-S27-04: reset → induce kill → sweep; mode-isolated oracle)
Let the bucket credential expire in a test fixture — alert fires, not a silent failure. (REDHAT-FIX-S27-04: reset → induce credential → sweep; mode-isolated oracle)
Remove the backup config entirely — the alert still fires as overdue, never a false-healthy state. (REDHAT-FIX-S27-04: reset → induce config-removed → sweep; mode-isolated oracle)

Healthy-run zero-alert silence gate (REDHAT-FIX-S27-06 / D04-05 AC-4 NEVER-tier): seed all jobs healthy via backup:healthy --all (S27-04 reset), run backup:alert-sweep, assert alerted: 0 and zero post[] lines — always-alert regressions cannot pass.

Execute D04-01 alerting oracle via REAL holo CLI (not vitest): healthy silence (alerted:0), then kill/credential/config-removed each fire mode-isolated alerts; independent HTTP captures + pre-fix payload-only baseline oracle (F-7).

Install and verify holocron-backup-alert-sweep launchd schedule (≤5min cadence) with ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL wired into the standing daemon env — standing alerts without dashboard polling (REDHAT-FIX-S27-10 / F-10).

Production 15-minute alert SLA + cadence (REDHAT-FIX-S27-08 / F-8 / T-PLAT-024): BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS unset (DEFAULT_OVERDUE_MS=900000); induce last_success_at age>15m; alert-sweep reports overdueMs>=900000 and overdue_by_minutes>=15; real webhook delivery. Toy BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS=500/1000 steps remain non-SLA mechanics only. Pure CLI — no vitest.
